$comment: Advisories the dependency audit gate tolerates. Every entry needs a reason: a bare 'inherited' is what this file exists to prevent. An entry that stops reporting makes the gate fail, so a fixed advisory cannot hide here.

accepted.name: brace-expansion
accepted.reason: Inherited from @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, not reachable from this package. The peer publishes an npm-shrinkwrap.json, which npm treats as authoritative for consumers and installs without re-resolving, so its pinned 5.0.9 survives every install. npm's own 'fixAvailable: true' is misleading here: overrides cannot pierce a dependency's shrinkwrap (verified for both top-level and path-scoped overrides). Upstream fix is a lockfile bump in the peer -- brace-expansion@5.0.12 already satisfies the ^5.0.8 range the peer's own minimatch declares. Remove this entry once a peer release past 0.99.2 ships the bump; tests/dependency-provenance.test.ts fails once the peer pin clears the advisory range.
